relationships.subject: CP55,940
relationships.evidence_quote: Within the spine of proestrus mice, 1 mg/kg of CP55,940 increased the expression of CB1R (p < .05) (Figure 3A).

relationships.subject: CP55,940
relationships.evidence_quote: For antinociception, 1 mg/kg CP55,940 significantly increased thermal antinociception in proestrus mice only (p < .001) (Figure 1C).

key_findings: Proestrus mice were more sensitive than metestrus mice to CP55,940 antinociception.
Spinal CB1R expression after CP55,940 was higher in proestrus than metestrus; CB2R unchanged.
